# C06 design: Matches and resumable upload

Covers MATCH01 to MATCH05, MATCH07, MATCH08, SQUAD05, SQUAD06 and NFR26, plus NFR17, NFR23, NFR24 and NFR27 on every new screen. HLS playback is C07 (MATCH06). Minutes played are computed in C06 but shown in C12.

Surfaces:

1. Match list grouped by status: `/matches`
2. Create match and edit match: `/matches/new`, `/matches/[matchId]/edit`
3. Upload screen: `/matches/[matchId]/upload` (choose, pre-check, progress, retry, offline, resume, cancel, errors)
4. Lineup entry with substitutions: `/matches/[matchId]/lineup`
5. Kickoff and half-time marker tool: `/matches/[matchId]/markers`
6. Match detail page: `/matches/[matchId]` (status panel, estimated finish, raw-footage countdown, lineup and marker summaries, delete)
7. `wl-progress` style in `components.css` and the `/dev/components` gallery

## Rules for the whole chunk

- **Earlier rules still apply (D01, D02, C01, C02, C04, C05).** Use tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities. Use spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 only. Set text with the type classes only (`heading-1`, `heading-2`, `display-xl`, `body-lg`, `body`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data`, `eyebrow`). Lucide icons go through `iconProps`, are `aria-hidden`, and always sit next to a word. The focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` rule.
- **Theme.** No C06 surface is forced dark. Every page follows the system setting. The marker tool is not the review workspace: its video sits in a `surface-sunken` well (`.wl-video`) in the page's theme.
- **Who.** Coaches do most of this work: they create the match, upload after the match (often from a laptop at the club office, sometimes from a phone on a weak connection), and enter lineups and markers. Club admins (owner, admin) do the same and are the only ones who delete. Design system row: "Upload and lineup: Coach. Resumable upload with progress, lineup entry, kickoff and half-time markers." The match list and detail page also serve "Club dashboard: matches by status".
- **Roles.** Every page calls `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)` and `requireSquadOrgPage`. Actions and route handlers use `MATCH_ROLES` (= `CLUB_ROLES`), except delete (`MATCH_DELETE_ROLES` = `ORG_ADMIN_ROLES`). Scouts, agencies and other roles go to `/forbidden` (C01 copy). Another organisation's match is `notFound()`.
- **One primary button per view.** A dialog is its own view. The primary on each page is named in its surface.
- **Page structure.** As C04: gutters `px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8`, `main` with `py-6 md:py-8 mx-auto max-w-7xl`. Sections are `mt-8` with an h2 in `heading-2` and `tabIndex={-1}` as a focus target. Form pages and the upload page sit in `max-w-2xl`.
- **Forms.** Reuse `useFormAction`, `Field`, `SubmitButton`, `FormBusy`, `useFocusFirstInvalid`, `Banner`, `SuccessBanner`, `FormErrorBanner` and `fieldError` from `components/forms.tsx`. Every form has `noValidate`. Under 768px inputs are 44px and submit buttons are `block` (48px, full width).
- **Results after a redirect.** `?done=<code>` maps to fixed copy in an always-rendered `div[aria-live="polite"]` under the header. Never echo URL text.

  | Page | Code | Banner (`ok`) |
  |---|---|---|
  | `/matches` | `deleted` | **Match deleted. Its footage, lineups and markers are being removed.** |
  | `/matches/[matchId]` | `created` | **Match created. Upload the footage next.** |
  | `/matches/[matchId]` | `updated` | **Changes saved.** |
  | `/matches/[matchId]` | `uploaded` | **Upload complete. We are checking the footage now. This usually takes a minute or two.** |

- **Children's data.** Player names appear on screen only. They never go into URLs, query strings, logs, audit metadata or `localStorage`. The uploader's `localStorage` record holds `{ videoId, fingerprint, fileName }` only.
- **Fixture text.** `fixtureText(m)` = **{home team name} v {away team name}** (lower-case `v`, team names as in Squad, no season). With markers, use `Fixture` (below).
- **Dates and times.** Africa/Johannesburg throughout. `formatDate()` ("18 Oct 2026") and `formatDateTime()` ("24 Oct 2026, 14:05"), in `data` inside table cells. Add to `src/lib/labels.ts`:
  - `formatMatchDate(d)`: weekday plus date, **Sat 18 Oct 2026**, for the detail hero.
  - `formatReadyBy(d, now)`: same day **15:40**; next day **09:10 tomorrow**; later **Mon 27 Oct, 09:10**.
  - `formatSize(bytes)`: under 1 GB **450 MB** (whole MB, 10^6), else `formatGB()` (**4.8 GB**, **8.59 GB**).
  - `formatSpeed(bytesPerSec)`: **3.4 MB/s** (one decimal), under 0.1 MB/s **under 0.1 MB/s**.
  - `formatEta(sec)`: **under 1 min**, **12 min**, **1 h 20 min**. Shown as "about {eta} left".
  - `formatFootageLength(sec)`: whole minutes, **92 min**.
  - `formatVideoTime(ms)`: video position, **47:12.4** (minutes not capped at 59: **112:31.0**). Always one decimal in the marker tool; whole seconds (**47:12**) in summaries.
- **Match minutes.** Substitution minutes are **60 min** in `data`. Match clock labels come from `videoMsToMatchClock` in `src/lib/match-clock.ts`: **31:24**, stoppage **45+2**, both in `data`.
- **Missing values** show `Missing` (en dash in `ink-muted`) in tables. A missing part of a sentence or meta line is left out, never shown as an empty separator.
- **Copy.** Sentence case, British and South African spelling, *match*, *pitch*, *squad*, *shirt number*, *kickoff*, *half-time*, *full time*. Never *game*, *field* or *roster*. No exclamation marks, no emoji.
- **Loading.** `/matches` inherits `(app)/loading.tsx` (`ListSkeleton`). Add `[matchId]/loading.tsx` (`DetailSkeleton`), `lineup/loading.tsx` (`ListSkeleton`), `markers/loading.tsx` (`WorkspaceSkeleton`), `upload/loading.tsx` (`DetailSkeleton`). Forms use pending labels and `aria-busy` (`FormBusy`).
- **Keyboard.** Only the marker tool has shortcuts (Surface 5). Everywhere else DOM order = visual order = tab order.
- **Motion.** Width changes on `wl-progress` animate 200ms ease-out, none under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Nothing spins: `LoaderCircle` is static, as in `MATCH_STATES`.

### Chip preset: `FOOTAGE_STATES` in `components/ui/StatusChip.tsx`

`FootageState = VideoStatus | "accepted_with_warnings"`. `FootageChip({ state })`, exported from `components/ui/index.ts`. Add one fixture per state to the `/dev/components` StatusChip group (light and dark).

| State | Tone | Icon | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| uploading | neutral | `Upload` | Uploading |
| probing | neutral | `LoaderCircle` | Checking footage |
| accepted | ok | `Check` | Accepted |
| accepted_with_warnings | warn | `TriangleAlert` | With warnings |
| rejected | danger | `X` | Rejected |
| cancelled | neutral | `CircleOff` | Cancelled |

The match chip stays `MatchStatusChip` (`MATCH_STATES`), unchanged.

### Footage issue copy, `src/lib/footage-rules.ts`

Each issue has `message` (what is wrong, `body-strong`) and `guidance` (how to re-film, `body`). The code comment marks the thresholds and guidance **Draft for review** (the plan's footage-rules question); the screen never says "draft". `{n}` values are numerals.

| Code | Severity | Message | Guidance |
|---|---|---|---|
| `no_video` | reject | This file has no video in it. | Export the match again from your camera's app as an MP4 or MOV file, then upload that file. |
| `unreadable` | reject | We could not read this file. | The file may be damaged or was still copying. Export it again from your camera's app and upload the new file. |
| `too_short` | reject | This video is {n} min long. A match recording needs at least 5 min. | Upload the whole match in one file, from before kickoff to after full time. |
| `low_resolution` | reject | This video is {w} × {h}. Wideline needs at least 1080p (1920 × 1080). | Set the camera to 1080p or higher before the next match, and export at the original quality. Phone apps often shrink exports to 720p. |
| `portrait` | reject | This video was filmed upright (portrait). | Turn the camera on its side (landscape) and mount it high on the halfway line, so the whole pitch is in the frame. |
| `low_fps` | reject | This video runs at {fps} frames per second. Wideline needs at least 20. | Set the camera to 25 or 30 frames per second. |
| `fps_marginal` | warn | This video runs at {fps} frames per second. Tracking works best at 25 or more. | Set the camera to 25 or 30 frames per second for the next match. |
| `not_wide` | warn | This video is narrower than 16:9, so it may not show the whole pitch. | Use a wide-angle camera, or a phone's 0.5× lens, high on the halfway line. Both goals should be in the frame. |
| `duration_short` | warn | This video is {n} min long. A match of 2 × {half} min usually runs longer. | Check that you uploaded the whole match, not one half. |
| `duration_long` | warn | This video is {n} min long, longer than a match. | You can keep it. Mark kickoff and full time, so only the match is analysed. |

`{fps}` shows up to one decimal, trailing zero dropped (**23.976** shows **24**, **29.97** shows **30**). Resolution shows the display size after rotation.

### CSS: append to the "Additions (not in bundle.css)" block in `web/src/styles/components.css`

Start with `/* Matches and upload for C06 (docs/build/design/C06.md). Not in the design system; built from tokens. */`. The design system has no progress, drop zone or video-well component; these are specified here from existing tokens.

| Rule | Spec |
|---|---|
| `.wl-progress` | The upload progress bar (Surface 7). Track: `display: block; height: var(--space-2); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--surface-sunken); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong); overflow: hidden`. |
| `.wl-progress__fill` | `display: block; height: 100%; width: var(--wl-progress, 0%); background: var(--pitch); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); transition: width 200ms ease-out`. `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { transition: none }`. The component sets `style={{ "--wl-progress": "52%" }}`: data, not a design value. |
| `.wl-progress--paused .wl-progress__fill` | `background: var(--warning)`. Used for paused, offline and retrying, always with words. |
| `.wl-progress--error .wl-progress__fill` | `background: var(--danger)`. |
| `.wl-progress__head` | `display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--space-3); margin-bottom: var(--space-2)`. File name left (`body-strong`, `min-w-0 break-all`), percent right (`data`, tabular). |
| `.wl-dropzone` | `display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-4); text-align: center; background: var(--surface-sunken); border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); transition: background 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out`. `[data-over="true"]`: `background: var(--pitch-soft); border-color: var(--pitch); border-style: solid`. Under 768px `padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-4)`. |
| `.wl-versus` | The home v away pair in the match form. `display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-3)`. `.wl-versus__v` is `heading-2 text-ink-muted` in markup, `text-align: center`. From 768px: `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; column-gap: var(--space-4)`; `.wl-versus__v { margin-top: calc(var(--space-6) + var(--space-1)) }` so it lines up with the selects. |
| `.wl-lineup` | The lineup sheet (`ul`). `display: flex; flex-direction: column`. Each `.wl-lineup__row` is a `fieldset` with `border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: var(--space-3) 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-2) var(--space-3)`. The `legend` (player) spans both columns (`float: left; width: 100%` so it joins the grid flow, then `grid-column: 1 / -1`). The selection field spans both columns; shirt number and position sit side by side. From 768px: `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 1fr) calc(var(--space-12) * 2) minmax(0, 1.5fr); align-items: center`; legend and selection no longer span; field labels become `sr-only`. `.wl-lineup__head` (768px and up only, `aria-hidden="true"`): the same grid, `label text-ink-muted`, `padding: var(--space-2) 0`. `.wl-lineup__row[data-selected="false"] .wl-lineup__name` is `ink-muted`. |
| `.wl-video` | The video well. `background: var(--surface-sunken); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9`. `.wl-video > video { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain }`. |
| `.wl-marker` | One marker row in the marker tool (`li`). `display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-2); padding: var(--space-3) 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line)`. `.wl-marker__actions` is a `wl-row`. From 768px to 1279px (stacked panes): `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: end` (field left, actions right). From 1280px the side pane is 4 columns wide, so `.wl-workspace__side .wl-marker` goes back to one column. |
| `.wl-issues` | Footage issues (`ul`). `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3)`. Each `li` is `display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-1) var(--space-2)`: icon (20px, `danger` for reject, `warning` for warn), then message (`body-strong`) and guidance (`body text-ink-muted`) in the second column. |

## Surface 1: match list, `/matches`

**Who, where, job.** Coaches and club admins, on a laptop or a phone. One job: see every match by where it is in the pipeline, and open the one that needs something.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)` + `requireSquadOrgPage`. Query params: `team` (an own team id; anything else is All teams, silently), `published=all`, `done`. Data: `listTeams(ctx)`, `listMatchesByStatus(ctx, { teamId })`. Metadata title: **Matches**.

### Structure (DOM order)

1. `ListPage` header: title **Matches**, intro **Matches for {organisation name}, by status.** With a team: **Matches for {teamLabel}, by status.** Action (when at least one own team exists and the list is not empty): `ButtonLink primary` **Create match** (`Plus`), href `/matches/new` plus `?team={id}` when a team is chosen. This is the page's primary.
2. Result banner live region (`deleted`).
3. Toolbar (only with 2 or more own teams), as `/squad`: `form method="get" action="/matches" class="wl-inline-form"`, `Field` **Team** with `select.wl-input name="team"`: **All teams**, then own teams by season (newest first) then name, as `teamLabel`. `Button secondary` **Show**.
4. Status groups, in this order, each only if it has matches: Draft, Uploading, Processing, Awaiting review, In review, Published, Failed. Each is a `section` (`mt-8`, the first `mt-6`) with `aria-labelledby`:
   - h2 `heading-2` with the `MATCH_STATES` label, then `span.data.text-ink-muted.ml-2` {count} and `span.sr-only` **matches** (one: **match**).
   - `DataTable` plus phone cards.
   - Published shows the 10 newest. With more: below the table, `Link body text-pitch underline wl-link-row` **Show all {n} published matches** → `?published=all` (keeps `team`). With `published=all`: **Show the 10 newest** → without it.

Order inside a group: `playedAt` newest first, then `createdAt` newest first.

### Table

Caption (sr-only): **{Group} matches, newest first**.

| Column | Header | Cell |
|---|---|---|
| match | **Match** | `Link` to `/matches/{id}` with class `body-strong text-pitch underline`, containing `TeamMarker side="home"` + ` v ` (`text-ink-muted`) + `TeamMarker side="away"`, wrapping between the two. |
| date | **Date** | `formatDate(playedAt)` in `data whitespace-nowrap` |
| competition | **Competition** | text, or `Missing` |
| footage | **Footage** | the footage line (below) |
| status | **Status** | `MatchStatusChip` |

### Footage line (`FootageLine`, one `span.wl-inline-status` with icon and caption text)

| Match and video | Modifier | Icon | Text |
|---|---|---|---|
| Draft, no video | `--muted` | `Upload` | **No footage yet** |
| Draft, latest video rejected | `--danger` | `X` | **Footage rejected** |
| Uploading, video uploading | `--warn` | `Upload` | **Upload not finished** |
| Uploading, video probing | `--muted` | `LoaderCircle` | **Checking footage** |
| Processing, estimate in the future | `--muted` | `Clock` | **Ready by about {formatReadyBy}** |
| Processing, estimate passed | `--warn` | `Clock` | **Taking longer than usual** |
| Awaiting review, In review, raw footage more than 72 h left | `--muted` | `Clock` | **Footage deleted in {formatTimeLeft}** |
| same, 72 h or less | — | — | `ExpiryLabel` (warning or danger chip, existing component) |
| Published or Failed, or footage already deleted | — | — | `Missing` |

### Phone cards (under 768px)

`li.wl-card.flex.flex-col.gap-2`:
1. Row `flex items-start justify-between gap-3`: the match `Link` (`wl-link-row`, 44px target) with the two `TeamMarker`s stacked (`flex flex-col gap-1`, `truncate`, the ` v ` dropped and replaced by `span.sr-only` **v**); `MatchStatusChip` on the right.
2. `p.caption.text-ink-muted`: `span.data` date, then **· {competition}** when set.
3. The footage line.

### States

- **Empty (no matches, own teams exist).** `EmptyState` title **No matches yet**, body **Create a match, upload the recording, then enter the lineups.** action `ButtonLink primary` **Create match**. The header action is hidden, so there is one primary.
- **No own teams.** `EmptyState` title **Add a team first**, body **A match needs your team and the opposition. Add them in Squad.** action `ButtonLink primary` **Go to teams** → `/squad/teams`.
- **Empty for a team filter.** `EmptyState art={false}` title **No matches for {teamLabel}**, body **Choose All teams to see every match.** No action (the toolbar is above).
- **Loading.** `ListSkeleton`.
- **Error.** `(app)/error.tsx`.
- **Forbidden.** `/forbidden`.
- **Long content.** Team names wrap (`break-words`); the table scrolls in its region. Long published history is capped at 10 per above.
- **Partial data.** Missing venue or competition is left out of cards and shows `Missing` in the table.

### Keyboard and screen readers

Tab order: Create match, Team select, Show, then each group's table region (focusable, labelled by the caption) and its links. Group h2s are landmarks through `section aria-labelledby`. The chip's word carries the state; the group heading repeats it.

## Surface 2: create match and edit match, `/matches/new`, `/matches/[matchId]/edit`

**Who, where, job.** A coach or club admin, usually on a laptop, sometimes on a phone after the match. One job: say who played whom, when and where, and how long the halves were.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)` + `requireSquadOrgPage`. `/matches/new` takes `team` (preselect own team) and `away` (preselect an opposition team after the round trip below). Metadata title: **Create match** / **Edit match**.

### Structure

`PageHeader`: back **Matches** (`/matches`) or **Match** (`/matches/{id}`); title **Create match** / **Edit match**; intro (create only) **You can upload the footage once the match is created.** Then `form.wl-card.mt-6.max-w-2xl` (`MatchForm`, client), fields in DOM order:

1. `div.wl-versus`:
   - `Field` **Home team** (`select.wl-input name="homeTeamId"`). Options: empty **Choose a team** (value ""), `optgroup` **Your teams** (own teams, `teamLabel`), `optgroup` **Opposition** (opposition teams, `teamLabel`). The label is plain text: no TeamMarker inside form labels.
   - `span.wl-versus__v aria-hidden="true"` **v**
   - `Field` **Away team** (`name="awayTeamId"`), same options.
   - Under the pair, `p.caption.text-ink-muted`: **Opposition not listed?** `Link text-pitch underline` **Add an opposition team** → `/squad/teams/new?kind=opposition&next=/matches/new`. The C04 team create action, given `next=/matches/new` (checked with `safeNextPath`, only this path allowed), redirects to `/matches/new?away={newTeamId}` instead of the team page. Shown on create only.
2. `Field` **Date** (`input type="date" name="playedAt"`), required. Default: today (Africa/Johannesburg).
3. `Field` **Venue** (`name="venue"`, `maxLength={120}`), hint **Optional. For example Dobsonville Stadium.**
4. `Field` **Competition** (`name="competition"`, `maxLength={120}`), hint **Optional. For example Gauteng Development League.**
5. `Field` **Half length (min)** (`input type="number" inputMode="numeric" name="halfLengthMinutes" min=10 max=60`, `w-full md:w-auto`, default 45), hint **Minutes in each half. Many U9 to U13 matches play 20 to 35.**
6. `FormErrorBanner`, then `SubmitButton block` **Create match** / **Save changes**, pending **Creating…** / **Saving…** (the page's primary). Edit adds `ButtonLink ghost` **Cancel** → match page.

Defaults on create: home = `team` param, else the only own team when there is exactly one; away = `away` param, else empty.

### Field errors

| Field | Rule | Copy |
|---|---|---|
| homeTeamId | empty | **Choose the home team.** |
| awayTeamId | empty | **Choose the away team.** |
| awayTeamId | same as home | **Choose a different team from the home team.** |
| awayTeamId | both opposition | **One side must be one of your teams.** |
| either | not in this organisation | **Choose a team from the list.** |
| either (edit) | lineup exists for the replaced team | **Remove the {home or away} lineup first. It lists players from {teamLabel}.** |
| playedAt | empty or invalid | **Enter the match date.** |
| venue, competition | over 120 | **Use 120 characters or fewer.** |
| halfLengthMinutes | not 10 to 60 | **Enter a half length from 10 to 60 minutes.** |
| halfLengthMinutes (edit) | a substitution is later than 2 × new half + 15 | **A substitution at {n} min is past the end of a 2 × {half} min match. Remove it first.** |

Form error (unexpected): **Something went wrong. Try again.** (C01 copy).

Success: create redirects to `/matches/{id}?done=created`; edit to `/matches/{id}?done=updated`.

### Layout

- 375: one column; the **v** sits centred between the two selects; button full width, 48px.
- 768 and 1280: home and away side by side with **v** between (`.wl-versus`); the other fields one column in `max-w-2xl`.

### States

- **No own teams.** Replace the form with `EmptyState art={false}` title **Add a team first**, body **A match needs your team and the opposition.** action `ButtonLink primary` **Go to teams**.
- **No opposition teams.** The Opposition optgroup is left out; the "Add an opposition team" line stays.
- **Edit, match locked.** Editing is allowed at every status (date and venue fixes are harmless). Team and half-length changes follow the server rules above.
- **Loading / error / forbidden.** `(app)/loading.tsx`, `(app)/error.tsx`, `/forbidden`. Another organisation's match on edit: `notFound()`.
- **Long content.** Team labels wrap inside the select's own UI; the form does not grow.

### Keyboard and screen readers

Tab order follows DOM: Home team, Away team, Add an opposition team, Date, Venue, Competition, Half length, submit. The **v** is `aria-hidden`. Errors: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`, focus to the first invalid field.

## Surface 3: upload screen, `/matches/[matchId]/upload`

**Who, where, job.** A coach after the match: on a laptop at the club office with a large file, or on a phone on mobile data. One job: get the match recording to Wideline, surviving a dropped connection (NFR26).

**Access.** `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)` + `requireSquadOrgPage`. Data: the match, its live video if any, `limitFor(orgId, "upload_max_bytes")` for the copy only (the server enforces it through `hasCapacity`). Metadata title: **Upload footage**. The client talks to the route handlers in `/api/matches/[matchId]/upload/*`.

### Structure

`PageHeader`: back **Match**; title **Upload footage**; intro **{fixtureText} · {formatDate(playedAt)}**. Then one column, `max-w-2xl`, at every breakpoint:

1. Live region `div[aria-live="polite"]` (banners from the uploader).
2. `section` **Before you upload** (h2 `heading-2`, `mt-6`) with `ul.wl-checklist.mt-4` (icon `Check` in `ink-muted`, `body`):
   - **The whole match in one file, from before kickoff to after full time.**
   - **Filmed in landscape from high on the halfway line, with both goals in the frame.**
   - **1080p or higher, at 25 frames per second or more.**
   - **MP4 or MOV, up to {formatGB(limit)}.**
   Hidden (collapsed into a `details` with summary **Before you upload**) once an upload is running, so the progress card stays near the top on phones.
3. `section` (`mt-8`, h2 `heading-2` per view below) with the upload card `div.wl-card`.

The `UploadPanel` (client) owns views; `MultipartUploader` from `src/lib/upload/multipart-client.ts` drives it.

### View: choose (no live video)

h2 **Choose the recording**.
- `label.wl-dropzone` wrapping a visually hidden `input type="file" accept=".mp4,.mov,video/mp4,video/quicktime"` (focusable, `sr-only` but not `display: none`; focus shows the ring on the drop zone via `:focus-within`). Contents: `Upload` icon (20px, `ink-muted`), `span.body-strong` **Choose a video file**, `span.caption.text-ink-muted` **or drag it here** (shown from 768px only), `span.caption.text-ink-muted` **MP4 or MOV, up to {formatGB(limit)}**. The whole zone is the tap target.
- Drag-over sets `data-over="true"`.
- After choosing: the **file summary** (below) replaces the drop zone.

### File summary and pre-check

`div.wl-stack`:
- `p.body-strong.break-all` file name; `p.caption.text-ink-muted` `span.data` **{formatSize}** · **{MP4 or MOV}**.
- While the browser reads metadata (at most 5 s, then skipped): `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Checking the file…**
- Pre-check passes or cannot read the file: no message. (The worker check is authoritative; an unreadable file in the browser is common for MOV and is not a warning.)
- Pre-check finds a problem: `Banner tone="warn"`: **This video looks like {w} × {h}. Footage under 1080p is rejected after upload.** or **This video looks like it was filmed upright (portrait). Portrait footage is rejected after upload.** Followed by `p.body` **Uploading takes time and data. Check the file first.**
- `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **This upload uses about {formatSize} of data. Use Wi-Fi if you can.**
- Actions (`wl-row`, buttons `block` on phones):
  - No warning: `Button primary` **Start upload** (`Upload`); `Button ghost` **Choose another file**.
  - Warning: `Button primary` **Choose another file**; `Button secondary` **Upload anyway**.

Client refusals (field-style error under the summary, `FieldErrorText`, focus moves to the drop zone input):
- Wrong type: **Choose an MP4 or MOV file.**
- Empty: **This file is empty. Choose the match video.**
- Too big: **This file is {formatSize}. The most you can upload for one match is {formatGB(limit)}.**

The server repeats each check; its 4xx answers map to the same copy.

### View: uploading

h2 **Uploading**. Card contents in DOM order:
1. `div.wl-progress__head`: `span.body-strong` file name; `span.data` **52%**.
2. `div.wl-progress role="progressbar" aria-labelledby={h2 id} aria-valuemin=0 aria-valuemax=100 aria-valuenow={whole percent} aria-valuetext="52%, 2.51 GB of 4.8 GB"` with `span.wl-progress__fill`.
3. `p.caption.data.mt-2` **{formatSize(sent)} of {formatSize(total)} · {formatSpeed} · about {formatEta} left**. In the first 10 s, or with no throughput yet: **{sent} of {total} · Working out time left…**
4. Status line slot (see retry and offline states).
5. Actions (`wl-row mt-4`): `Button secondary` **Pause upload** (`Pause`); `Button danger` **Cancel upload** (`X`). No primary while running.
6. `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-4` **Keep this page open until the upload finishes. If it stops, come back here and choose the same file to carry on.**

While uploading, the page registers `beforeunload` (the browser shows its own wording).

Screen readers: a separate `span.sr-only[aria-live="polite"]` announces **Uploaded 10%**, **Uploaded 20%** … at each 10% step only; the visible percent is not live.

Progress never goes backwards: a failed part's bytes are not counted until the part succeeds (rule in the client).

### States while uploading

| State | Bar | Status line (in the card, `Banner`) | Buttons |
|---|---|---|---|
| Running | `pitch` | none | Pause upload, Cancel upload |
| Retrying after a failed part | `--paused` | `tone="warn"`: **Connection lost. Retrying in {n} s.** The seconds are in an `aria-hidden` span that ticks; the live text is **Connection lost. Retrying automatically.** | `Button ghost sm` **Retry now** in the banner; Pause, Cancel |
| Offline (`navigator.onLine` false or the `offline` event) | `--paused` | `tone="warn"` (icon `WifiOff`): **Paused: you are offline. The upload carries on when you reconnect.** | Cancel upload |
| Paused by the user | `--paused` | none; the head reads **Paused at 52%** in place of the percent | `Button primary` **Resume upload** (`Play`); Cancel upload |
| Part URLs expired (403) | unchanged | none (fresh URLs are fetched silently) | unchanged |
| Missing parts on complete (409) | unchanged | `tone="warn"` after the second attempt only: **Some parts did not arrive. Sending them again.** | unchanged |
| Finishing (complete call) | 100%, `pitch` | head percent reads **100%**; caption **Finishing upload…** | all disabled |
| Complete | — | — | navigates to `/matches/{id}?done=uploaded` |

### Cancel dialog

A client `dialog.wl-dialog` with the `ConfirmDialog` structure (title `heading-2`, body `body`, `.wl-dialog__actions`), focus starts on the safe button:
- Title **Cancel this upload?**
- Body **The {formatSize(sent)} uploaded so far is thrown away. You can start again with the same file or another one.**
- `Button secondary` **Keep uploading**; `Button danger` **Cancel upload**, pending **Cancelling…**.

After cancel: back to the choose view, with `Banner tone="ok"` **Upload cancelled. Choose a file to start again.** Focus moves to the h2.

### View: resume (a live upload exists)

When the server has an `uploading` video for this match. h2 **Carry on uploading**.
- `Banner tone="warn"` (icon `Clock`): **The upload of {fileName} stopped at {percent}%. Choose the same file to carry on from there.** `{percent}` comes from `uploadStatus` (ListParts).
- The drop zone (as above) with the text **Choose {fileName}**.
- After a file is chosen and the fingerprint matches: the uploading view starts with the caption **Resuming from 52%** for its first update, then the normal caption.
- Fingerprint does not match: `FieldErrorText` **This is not the file you started with ({fileName}, {formatSize}). Choose that file, or cancel the upload to start again.**
- `Button danger` **Cancel upload and start again** (opens the cancel dialog; the body says **The {formatSize} uploaded so far is thrown away.**).

Works without `localStorage` (another device, private window): the server's file name, size and fingerprint drive the same view.

### Other views and errors

- **Checking footage (video probing).** h2 **Upload complete**; `p.body` **We are checking the footage. This usually takes a minute or two.** `ButtonLink primary` **Back to match**.
- **Footage accepted, or the match is past Uploading.** `EmptyState art={false}` title **Footage already uploaded**, body **This match has accepted footage. To use a different recording, an owner or admin deletes the match and you create it again.** action `ButtonLink primary` **Back to match**.
- **Upload no longer exists** (cancelled on another device, or the server answers 404 or 409 for the video): `Banner tone="danger"` **This upload was cancelled, so it cannot carry on. Choose your file to start again.** Back to the choose view.
- **Start refused because the plan limit changed:** the too-big copy above.
- **Server error on start or complete (5xx), online.** Retries with the same backoff as parts; shows the Retrying state. No fatal error while online.
- **Not signed in any more (401) or no role (403 from the API).** `Banner tone="danger"` **You have been signed out. Sign in again, then come back here and choose the same file to carry on.** with `ButtonLink secondary` **Sign in** → `/sign-in?next=/matches/{id}/upload`.
- **Loading.** `DetailSkeleton`. **Error.** `(app)/error.tsx`. **Forbidden.** `/forbidden`.
- **Long content.** File names break anywhere (`break-all`); the percent never wraps.

### Layout

One column in `max-w-2xl` at 375, 768 and 1280. At 375 every button is full width (48px) and stacked; the drop zone is shorter (`space-6` padding). No sidebar content.

### Keyboard and screen readers

Tab order: back link, the file input (inside the drop zone), file summary buttons, then Pause, Cancel. Enter or Space on the focused drop zone opens the file picker (native input). The progress bar has a label and value text. Retry and offline banners are `role="status"`; the error banners `role="alert"`. When the view changes (choose, uploading, resume, done), focus moves to the new h2 (`tabIndex={-1}`).

## Surface 4: lineup entry with substitutions, `/matches/[matchId]/lineup`

**Who, where, job.** A coach, on a laptop after the match or on a phone in the changing room. One job: record who started, who was on the bench, their shirt numbers and positions, and every substitution with its minute (SQUAD05, SQUAD06).

**Access.** `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)` + `requireSquadOrgPage`. Query: `side=home|away` (default: the side that is an own team; home when both are). Data: `getLineups(ctx, matchId)`, `pickerFor(ctx, teamId)`. Metadata title: **Lineups**.

### Structure

1. `PageHeader`: back **Match**; title **Lineups**; intro **{fixtureText} · {formatDate(playedAt)}**.
2. Side tabs: `nav.wl-tabs.mt-6 aria-label="Side"` with two links keeping the path: each contains `TeamMarker side=… name={team name} truncate`, then `span.data.text-ink-muted` {row count} with `span.sr-only` **players**. `aria-current="page"` on the active side.
3. Locked banner (when the match is In review or Published): `Banner tone="warn"` **Lineups are locked while this match is in review.** / **Lineups are locked because this match is published.** Everything below renders read-only (plain text in the same layout, no inputs, no buttons).
4. `section` **Players** (h2 `heading-2`, `mt-6`): intro `p.body.text-ink-muted.mt-2` **Choose who started and who was on the bench. Shirt numbers can differ from squad numbers.** Then the lineup form.
5. `section` **Substitutions** (`mt-8`).

### Lineup form (`LineupEditor`, client; one form per side)

- Live region for `SuccessBanner`.
- Counter `p.body.mt-4` with `aria-live="polite"`: `span.data` **11** **starters** · `span.data` **5** **substitutes**.
- `div.wl-lineup__head` (768px and up): **Player**, **Selection**, **Shirt**, **Position**.
- `ul.wl-lineup` of rows. Each row is `li > fieldset.wl-lineup__row data-selected=…`:
  - `legend.wl-lineup__name`: `span.body-strong` player name (`playerName`, placeholders **Unnamed #7**), then `span.caption.text-ink-muted` **Squad no. 7** when the player has a squad number.
  - `Field` **Selection**: `select.wl-input name="rows[{playerId}].selection"` with **Not selected** (`none`), **Starter**, **Substitute**. Existing rows preselect their value.
  - `Field` **Shirt number**: `input type="number" inputMode="numeric" min=1 max=99`, prefilled from the existing lineup row, else `Player.squadNumber`, else empty. Placeholders (opposition): `readOnly`, value = the placeholder's number.
  - `Field` **Position**: `select.wl-input` with **No position** then `POSITIONS` labels, prefilled from the lineup row, else `Player.position`.
  - With Selection **Not selected**, the shirt and position controls are `disabled` (client) and the server ignores them.
- Row order: Starters first, then Substitutes, then Not selected; inside each, shirt or squad number ascending (blanks last), then last name. The order is computed on load only; changing a select does not move rows (focus stays put).
- **Departed players already in this lineup** (own side only): after the list, `h3.body-strong.mt-6` **Players who have left the club**, then read-only rows: name, `ClubStatusChip`, **Starter** or **Substitute**, `span.data` shirt number, position. `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **They stay in this lineup. You cannot change their rows.**
- `FormErrorBanner`, then `SubmitButton block` **Save lineup**, pending **Saving…**. The page's primary.

Field errors (on the row's control; the summary banner above the button says **Check the highlighted rows.**):

| Rule | Copy |
|---|---|
| Starter or substitute without a shirt number, or out of range | **Enter a shirt number from 1 to 99.** |
| Shirt number used twice on this side | **Shirt number {n} is already used by {other player name}.** (on both rows) |
| More than 11 starters | form error: **A side can start with 11 players at most. You chose {n}.** |
| Player departed, from another team or organisation (server) | form error: **Some players can no longer be picked. Reload the page and try again.** |

Success (`SuccessBanner`, key per save): **Lineup saved.** When substitutions were removed because a player left the lineup: **Lineup saved. {n} substitution(s) removed because a player is no longer selected.** (`substitution` / `substitutions`).

Opposition side extra, below the form (not inside it): `form.wl-card.mt-6` reusing the C04 placeholder pattern: `Field` **Add shirt numbers** (hint **Separate with commas, or use a range. For example 1-11, 14.**), `SubmitButton` secondary **Add players**, pending **Adding…**. Success: **{n} players added.** and the list reloads.

### Substitutions section

h2 **Substitutions**, intro `p.body.text-ink-muted.mt-2` **Add each change with the minute it happened. Minutes played are worked out from these.**

- **No saved lineup on this side:** `p.body.mt-4` **Save the lineup first. Then add substitutions.** Nothing else.
- List: `ul.mt-4` with `line` dividers, ordered by minute, each `li.flex.flex-wrap.items-center.gap-3.py-3`:
  - `span.data` **60 min**
  - `span.body` **Off:** `span.body-strong` **#9 Sipho Dlamini**
  - `span.body` **On:** `span.body-strong` **#14 Kagiso Mokoena**, or `span.body.text-ink-muted` **No replacement**
  - `Button ghost sm` **Remove** with `aria-label` **Remove the substitution at 60 min** (not on locked matches).
- Empty list: `p.body.mt-4.text-ink-muted` **No substitutions yet.**
- Add form `form.wl-card.mt-4` (`Substitutions`, client), fields in a grid (one column at 375; three columns from 768):
  - `Field` **Minute** (`input type="number" inputMode="numeric" min=1 max={2 × half + 15}`), hint **1 to {max}.**
  - `Field` **Player off**: `select` with **Choose a player** then players on the pitch (starters and substitutes who came on, not yet off), as **#{shirt} {name}**.
  - `Field` **Player on**: `select` with **Choose a player**, unused substitutes as **#{shirt} {name}**, then **No replacement (injury or red card)** (`value="none"`).
  - `SubmitButton` secondary **Add substitution**, pending **Adding…**.

| Rule | Copy |
|---|---|
| minute empty or out of range | **Enter a minute from 1 to {max}.** |
| player off empty | **Choose the player who came off.** |
| player off not on the pitch at that minute (server) | **{#9 Sipho Dlamini} was not on the pitch at {n} min.** |
| player on empty | **Choose who came on, or No replacement.** |
| player on already came on | **{#14 Kagiso Mokoena} has already come on.** |

Success: **Substitution added.**; the form clears and focus returns to Minute. Remove: no dialog (it is easy to add again); success **Substitution removed.**, focus to the Substitutions h2.

### Layout

- 375: tabs scroll sideways if long (`wl-tabs` already does). Each lineup row is a stacked block: name line, Selection full width, then Shirt and Position side by side. Substitution form one column, button full width.
- 768: lineup rows become a four-column grid with a header row; labels go `sr-only`. Substitution form three columns, button below.
- 1280: same as 768 inside `max-w-7xl`; the lineup form is capped at `max-w-4xl` so rows stay readable.

### States

- **Empty own team.** In the Players section: `EmptyState art={false}` title **No current players in {teamLabel}**, body **Add players to the squad first.** action `ButtonLink secondary` **Add player** → `/squad/players/new?team={id}`.
- **Empty opposition team.** `p.body.mt-4` **No shirt numbers yet for {teamLabel}. Add the numbers their players wore.** with the Add shirt numbers form.
- **Small sample.** A 7-a-side lineup is normal: no minimum starter count, no warning.
- **Long content.** 30-player squads: the list is long but each row is one line from 768px. Long names wrap inside the legend.
- **Locked.** As above; read-only.
- **Loading / error / forbidden.** `ListSkeleton`, `(app)/error.tsx`, `/forbidden`; another organisation's match `notFound()`.

### Keyboard and screen readers

Tab order: tabs, then per row Selection, Shirt number, Position, then Save lineup; then Substitutions: Remove buttons in list order, Minute, Player off, Player on, Add substitution. Each row is a `fieldset` whose `legend` names the player, so "Selection, Thabo Nkosi, group" is announced. Disabled controls are skipped. Errors focus the first invalid control.

## Surface 5: kickoff and half-time marker tool, `/matches/[matchId]/markers`

**Who, where, job.** A coach, on a laptop (on a phone it works, with typed times as the easy path). One job: mark kickoff, half-time, second-half kickoff and full time in the video, so video time maps to match minutes (MATCH05).

**Access.** `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)` + `requireSquadOrgPage`. Data: the accepted video (`durationSec`, the four markers), `halfLengthMinutes`. The video plays from `GET /api/matches/[matchId]/video-url`, a 15-minute signed URL (NFR17); C07 replaces it with HLS. Metadata title: **Kickoff and half-time**.

### Structure

1. `PageHeader`: back **Match**; title **Kickoff and half-time**; intro **Mark four moments in the video, so video time maps to match minutes.**
2. Live region (success banner).
3. `Workspace` template (no theme override): primary pane **Video**, side pane **Markers**. Side by side at 1280 (8 and 4 columns); stacked below.

**Video pane.**
- `div.wl-video` with `<video controls preload="metadata" playsInline aria-label="Match video">`. Captions: the raw file has none; C07 adds tracks.
- Readout `dl.wl-row.mt-3` (`label` terms, `data` values): **Video time** `47:12.4`; **Match clock** `31:24 · First half` (or `45+2:10 · First half`, `Half-time`, `Before kickoff`, `After full time`), shown once kickoff is set.
- Controls `div.wl-row.mt-3` (all `Button secondary sm`, `block`-free, wrap): **Play** / **Pause** (`Play`/`Pause`, `Kbd` K), **Back 1 s** (`Kbd` ←), **Back 0.1 s** (`Kbd` ,), **Forward 0.1 s** (`Kbd` .), **Forward 1 s** (`Kbd` →).
- `details.mt-3` with `summary.label` **Keyboard shortcuts** and a `dl` listing: K play or pause; ← and → move 1 s; , and . move 0.1 s; 1, 2, 3 and 4 set kickoff, half-time, second-half kickoff and full time to the current time.

**Markers pane.** `form` (`MarkerTool`, client) with `ul` of four `li.wl-marker`:

| Marker | Label | Hint | Set button |
|---|---|---|---|
| kickoffMs | **Kickoff** | **The first whistle.** | **Set kickoff here** `Kbd` 1 |
| halfTimeMs | **Half-time** | **The whistle that ends the first half.** | **Set half-time here** `Kbd` 2 |
| secondHalfKickoffMs | **Second-half kickoff** | **The whistle that starts the second half.** | **Set second-half kickoff here** `Kbd` 3 |
| fullTimeMs | **Full time** | **The final whistle.** | **Set full time here** `Kbd` 4 |

Each row: `Field` with the label, an `input.wl-input` (text, `inputMode="decimal"`, `autoComplete="off"`, name as the key) holding `formatVideoTime`, hint **{hint} For example 2:31.** Under it `.wl-marker__actions`: `Button secondary sm` the Set button; `Button ghost sm` **Go to** with `aria-label` **Go to {marker} in the video** (disabled when empty).

Derived captions (`caption text-ink-muted`, after the row, once both ends are set):
- under Half-time: **First half: {n} min ({clock}).** for example **First half: 47 min (45+2).**
- under Full time: **Second half: {n} min ({clock}).**

Then `FormErrorBanner`, `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Unsaved changes** (only when dirty), `SubmitButton block` **Save markers**, pending **Saving…**. The page's primary. Blank markers may be saved; order is checked among those set.

| Rule | Copy |
|---|---|
| cannot parse | **Enter a time like 2:31 or 47:12.4.** |
| past the end of the video | **The video ends at {formatVideoTime(duration)}.** |
| half-time not after kickoff | **Half-time must be after kickoff.** |
| second-half kickoff before half-time | **Second-half kickoff must be at or after half-time.** |
| full time not after second-half kickoff | **Full time must be after second-half kickoff.** |

Success: **Markers saved. Match minutes now follow these times.** While dirty, `beforeunload` is registered.

### Playback states

- **Loading the video.** The well shows `wl-skeleton--video` until `loadedmetadata`.
- **Cannot play** (the `error` event with `MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED` or `MEDIA_ERR_DECODE`, or `canPlayType` empty for the file type): the video well, readout and controls are replaced by `Banner tone="warn"` **This browser cannot play your video file. Type the times instead: play the file on your computer or camera, and note the time at each whistle.** The Set and Go to buttons are hidden; typed entry stays. Shortcuts 1 to 4 and the transport keys are off.
- **Signed URL expired** (network `error` after about 15 min): fetch a new URL once, restore `currentTime` and paused state, no message. If the refetch fails: `Banner tone="danger"` **The video stopped loading. Reload the page to carry on. Unsaved times are kept until you leave.**
- **No accepted footage.** Replace the workspace with `EmptyState art={false}` title **Upload footage first**, body **You can mark kickoff and half-time once the footage is accepted.** action `ButtonLink primary` **Upload footage** (match is Draft) or **Back to match** (footage is still being checked).
- **Locked** (In review or Published): `Banner tone="warn"` **Markers are locked while this match is in review.** / **Markers are locked because this match is published.** The video still plays; the markers show as text; no Set, Save or shortcuts 1 to 4.
- **Error / forbidden.** `(app)/error.tsx`, `/forbidden`; another organisation's match `notFound()`.

### Layout

- 375: video full width, readout, controls wrapping onto two rows (44px targets), then the four marker rows stacked, Save full width at the end. Typed entry works the same on phones; each hint carries **For example 2:31.**
- 768: stacked panes; each marker row is two columns (field, then actions) via `.wl-marker`.
- 1280: video 8 columns, markers 4 columns; marker rows single column in the side pane.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Shortcuts act when focus is inside the tool (`div` wrapping the workspace) and not in a text input, select or textarea; they `preventDefault` so the native video does not also seek. Every shortcut has a visible button showing its `Kbd`.
- Tab order: video (native controls), Play, Back 1 s, Back 0.1 s, Forward 0.1 s, Forward 1 s, Keyboard shortcuts, then per marker: input, Set, Go to; then Save markers.
- Setting a marker from a button or key updates the input and announces through a `span.sr-only[aria-live="polite"]`: **Kickoff set to 2:31.4.** Go to moves the video and keeps focus on the button.
- The readout is not live (it changes many times a second).

## Surface 6: match detail page, `/matches/[matchId]`

**Who, where, job.** Coaches and club admins, on a laptop or a phone. One job: see where this match is (footage, checks, processing, review) and what to do next; owners and admins can delete it (MATCH07, MATCH08).

**Access.** `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)` + `requireSquadOrgPage`. Data: `getMatch(ctx, matchId)` with the latest video, lineup counts per side, substitution counts, markers, `estimatedReadyAt(video)`. Metadata title: `fixtureText`.

### Structure (`DetailPage`)

- back **Matches** (`/matches`).
- eyebrow: competition, else **Match**.
- title: `fixtureText`.
- meta: **{formatMatchDate} · {venue} · 2 × {half} min** (missing parts left out).
- badges: `MatchStatusChip`; `FootageChip` when a video exists and the match is Draft or Uploading; `ExpiryLabel` when raw footage has 72 h or less.
- actions: the next step as the one primary (below), plus `ButtonLink secondary sm` **Edit match** (`Pencil`) → `/edit`.
- notice: the `done` banner live region, then `ExpiryBanner` (72 h or less; children **After that, nobody can review this match again or add missed events. Stats already confirmed are kept.**).
- sections: Footage, Lineups, Kickoff and half-time, Delete match.

**Next-step primary** (`ButtonLink primary`, in `actions`):

| Condition | Label | Href |
|---|---|---|
| Draft, no video or rejected | **Upload footage** (`Upload`) | `/upload` |
| Uploading, video uploading | **Carry on uploading** (`Upload`) | `/upload` |
| Footage accepted, no lineup on an own side | **Enter lineups** (`Users`) | `/lineup` |
| Footage accepted, markers not all set | **Set kickoff and half-time** (`Flag`) | `/markers` |
| otherwise | none |

### Section: Footage (`aria-live="polite"` on the section body, so a poll result is announced)

`div.wl-card` with a first row `wl-row`: `FootageChip` (or nothing when there is no video) and the content per state:

| Video state | Content |
|---|---|
| none | `p.body` **No footage yet. Upload the whole match from your wide-angle camera: MP4 or MOV, up to {formatGB(limit)}.** |
| uploading | `p.body` **Upload in progress: {percent}% of {formatSize}.** `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **The upload runs in the browser that started it. Open the upload page and choose the same file to carry on.** |
| probing | `p.body` **We are checking the footage. This usually takes a minute or two.** (`StatusPoller` refreshes every 10 s while the tab is visible.) |
| accepted | the footage facts (below), then match-status text |
| accepted with warnings | `Banner tone="warn"` **Footage accepted with {n} warning(s). We will still process it.** then `ul.wl-issues`, then the facts |
| rejected | `Banner tone="danger"` **This footage cannot be used.** then `ul.wl-issues`, then `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **We keep the rejected file until {formatDeletionDate(rawExpiresAt)}, then delete it.** The next-step primary is Upload footage. |

Footage facts (`dl.wl-facts.mt-4`): **Length** `92 min`; **Resolution** `1920 × 1080`; **Frame rate** `25 fps`; **File** `{fileName} · {formatSize}`; **Uploaded** `formatDateTime(uploadedAt)`; **Raw footage deleted** `{formatDeletionDate(rawExpiresAt)}, in {formatTimeLeft}` (past: **Deleted**). Numbers in `data`.

Match-status text (`p.body.mt-4`, after the facts, by match status):

| Status | Copy |
|---|---|
| processing, estimate in the future | **Processing. Ready for review by about {formatReadyBy}.** |
| processing, estimate passed | **Processing is taking longer than usual. This page updates when it is ready.** |
| awaiting_review | **Ready for review. A scout picks it up from the review queue.** |
| in_review | **A scout is reviewing this match.** |
| published | **Published. Stats from this match are on player profiles.** |
| failed | **Processing failed. Wideline staff have been told and will try again.** |

`StatusPoller` also runs while the match is Processing (every 30 s), so the estimate and later states appear without a reload. It stops when the tab is hidden.

### Section: Lineups

`ul.wl-stack` with one line per side: `TeamMarker` + `span.body` **{n} starters · {n} substitutes · {n} substitutions** or `span.body.text-ink-muted` **Not entered yet**. Then `ButtonLink secondary sm` **Enter lineups** (no rows on either side) or **Edit lineups** (locked: **View lineups**) → `/lineup`.

### Section: Kickoff and half-time

- No accepted footage: `p.body.text-ink-muted` **You can set these once the footage is accepted.**
- Otherwise `dl.wl-facts`: **Kickoff**, **Half-time**, **Second-half kickoff**, **Full time**, each `formatVideoTime` in whole seconds (`data`) or **Not set**. Then `ButtonLink secondary sm` **Set markers** / **Change markers** (locked: none) → `/markers`.

### Section: Delete match

- Owners and admins: `p.body.text-ink-muted` **Deleting a match removes its footage, lineups, markers and everything worked out from them, such as stats and clips.** then `ConfirmDialog`:
  - trigger `danger` **Delete match** (`Trash2`), `block` on phones.
  - title **Delete this match?**
  - body **This deletes {fixtureText} on {formatDate}, with its footage, lineups and markers, and every stat and clip from it. You cannot undo this.** While an upload is running elsewhere, add **The upload in progress stops.**
  - submit `danger` **Delete match**, pending **Deleting…**. Success redirects to `/matches?done=deleted`.
  - error: **The match could not be deleted. Try again.**
- Coaches: `p.body.text-ink-muted` **Only owners and admins can delete a match.** No button.

### Layout

- 375: hero `heading-1` title; meta wraps; badges wrap; actions stack full width. Sections stack; facts one column (`wl-facts`).
- 768: `display-xl` title; facts two columns (`max-content 1fr`).
- 1280: same, sections in `max-w-3xl` so text lines stay short.

### States

- **Partial data.** Missing venue or competition left out; footage facts drop unknown values (for example frame rate when the probe could not read it).
- **Long content.** Long team names wrap in the title (`break-words`); long file names `break-all`.
- **Polling.** When the poll changes the footage state, the section re-renders inside its live region; focus is not moved.
- **Loading.** `DetailSkeleton`. **Error.** `(app)/error.tsx`. **Forbidden.** `/forbidden`. **Not found.** `notFound()` (another organisation's match, or deleted).

### Keyboard and screen readers

Tab order: back link, next-step primary, Edit match, section links in order, Delete match. Section h2s are focus targets. The status poller never steals focus. Chips carry words; TeamMarkers carry H/A and an sr-only side name.
